status: specified after prior primary and secondary results, before these new outcomes; exploratory, not public preregistration
data: Frozen BUS-BRA CSV and supplied five patient-disjoint outer folds; no changes to predictor values
inner_search: same 32 SVM settings, three StratifiedGroupKFold splits; no tuning on outer outcomes

label_noise.rule: Within each outer training partition, flip floor(rate * number of patients in each original diagnosis) whole patient groups, with RandomState(42+outer_fold), sorted group keys. The same corrupted labels enter inner fitting and validation. Outer test labels remain unchanged. Rebuild inner stratification from corrupted labels.
label_noise.scope: One corruption draw per outer fold/rate, shared across methods; descriptive stress test, not a population noise-robustness guarantee

controlled_gbfrs_ablation.construction: identical reconstruction balls, purity0.90 seed42, minmax geometry and normalized stopping
controlled_gbfrs_ablation.question: Change dependency expression only; not a full reproduction of author software

gbfrs_sensitivity.rule: Separate prespecified sensitivity runs; do not choose a new best setting from their outer scores

failure_policy: Record failures without fallback or silent source changes
independent_ultrasound: Attempt official BrEaST access. Missing original BUS-BRA extraction configuration prevents exact frozen-model external validation. Any new extraction study must have its own protocol, source hashes, and be labeled independent-cohort method evaluation.
